# Dynamical_State_Space

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The temporal evolution of reservoir node activations that serves as a memory trace of past inputs. Provides inherent short-term memory without explicit delay lines, crucial for time-series processing in neuromorphic in-network computing.
